challenges.title: Many campuses, online and on site
challenges.text: Courses, students and staff are spread across two campuses, several centres and online study, and all of them need one consistent record.

challenges.title: Administrative work done by hand
challenges.text: Enrolment, scheduling and reporting steps consumed staff time that should go to students.

challenges.title: Student records are protected data
challenges.text: Education records need strict role-based access and an audit trail.

results: One platform for courses, students and academic operations
Dashboards for enrolment and student progress
Role-based access for students, faculty and staff
name: Park University
headline: A university platform for managing courses, students and day-to-day academic operations
overview: Park University is a private, nonprofit university founded in 1875, with campuses in Parkville, Missouri and Gilbert, Arizona, campus centres across the US and more than 65 online degrees. Techlio built its platform for managing courses, students and academic operations, from discovery and design through development, deployment and support, with automated workflows and dashboards for staff.

metrics.label: academic programmes offered by the university

solutions.title: Course and programme management
solutions.text: Programmes, courses, sections and schedules managed in one place across online and on-campus delivery.

solutions.title: Student records and enrolment
solutions.text: Student profiles, enrolment and progress tracked through each term, with self-service for students and tools for advisers and faculty.

solutions.title: Workflow automation
solutions.text: Routine steps such as enrolment confirmations, reminders, approvals and report generation run automatically.

solutions.title: Dashboards for staff
solutions.text: Dashboards that show enrolment, course load and student progress so departments can act on current numbers.

solutions.title: Security built in
solutions.text: Techlio's security baseline applied from the first sprint: OWASP-based secure coding and review, role-based access control, encryption in transit and at rest, least-privilege access to cloud resources and vulnerability scans before each release. For Park that means access by role for students, faculty and administrators, and student records designed around education privacy requirements.
